card.name: Size word after "In a" before trials
card.fires_on: The size word "large" (or "small") right after "In a" at the start of a sentence introducing a study or trial, mostly in warnings and adverse reaction sections.

card.writes: It seems to push for words that go on to describe a study, but the listed tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the word "large" or "small" when a label sentence starts with "In a" and is about to describe a study.
